name: standart-npc
author: MondoTruth, Lil Art, IceGlaive, Nokzin, iguera, Claude, and the Ragnarok Offline community
description: ⚠ Some NPCs may need the Cash Shop for full functionality. Turning the mod on turns on every NPC; switch single ones off with Settings… (Warper, Job Master, Reset Girl, Stylist, Episode Valkyrie and all the others).

settings.label: Switched-off NPCs
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window: the always-loaded NPCs (Warper, Job Master, Reset Girl, Stylist, Episode Valkyrie, Falcon Breeder) that are unticked there. Empty = all on.

settings.label: Buffer
settings.description: Free instant buffs + full heal on click. Every major town. Buffs are chosen in the Settings… window.

settings.label: Buffer: buffs
settings.description: Filled in by the Settings… window (Buffer → Choose buffs): the buffs the Buffer casts, as a comma-separated list of codes.

settings.label: Card Exchanger
settings.description: Trade cards for an album, or pull one out of your gear. Prontera (151,187).

settings.label: Kafra Employee
settings.description: Save point, storage, free identify. Prontera (160,187).

settings.label: Smuggler
settings.description: Buy any item by ID. Prontera (144,174).

settings.label: Bounty Hunter
settings.description: Hunting contracts in one NPC, the Bounty Hunter, Prontera (147,172); one contract per board at a time. Target Hunt (was Gramps): pick a map, Lv 70 to 231+, EXP. Overlook Water Dungeon: Lv 30-85, 4 floors in order, each once; all 4 = a card of your choice. Illusion Dungeons: 9 dungeons from Lv 99, EXP. Daily Area Purge (was Lucky John): once a day, any 500 monsters in a random area, EXP and Zeny.

settings.label: Cheffenia MVP Dungeon
settings.description: Timed MVP dungeon access, paid in Zeny or Cash Points. Prontera (140,180).

settings.label: Safe Refiner
settings.description: Refines gear to +7 through +15 using certificates. Prontera (164,172).

settings.label: Grade Refiner
settings.description: Opens the equipment grading UI and the refining UI. Renewal only: hidden and switched off on Pre-renewal. By Lil Art. Prontera (164,166).

settings.label: Universal Enchanter
settings.description: Attaches an Enchant/Class Stone to costume, shadow or regular gear, for free. By Lil Art. Prontera (164,169).

settings.label: Master Nokzin
settings.description: Endows your weapon with an element for an hour, removable for free. Prontera (167,178).

settings.label: Weight Maxxer
settings.description: Trades a Gym Pass for +1 permanent carry capacity, up to 10 times. Prontera (147,169).

settings.label: Plagiarism Master
settings.description: Rogue line: copy any Plagiarism-copyable skill, level capped by your Plagiarism level. By iguera. Prontera (171,182).

settings.label: Daily Rewards
settings.description: Distributes daily attendance rewards, once every 24 hours. By Lil Art. Prontera (147,166).

settings.label: Training Dummies
settings.description: Stationary target dummies for testing damage output. Prontera (153-158,163).
